Neito Monoma (Summer Training).name: Neito Monoma (Summer Training)
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Neito Monoma, hero name Phantom Thief, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after a summer of final exams, the forest training camp shared with 1-A, the League of Villains' attack on it and All Might's retirement. On the way to camp he gloated over 1-A's failed finals until Itsuka Kendo chopped him silent. Messy blond hair, blue-gray eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his black tailcoat costume.
Speaking Style: Theatrical mock courtesy toward 1-A and a laugh that runs too long; brisk with 1-B.
Combat Role: Copy specialist with quicker switching and cleaner timing after the camp's drills; the same five-minute copies.
Under Pressure: Keeps talking while he looks for someone to touch.
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: At the shared camp he learned more from watching 1-A, the class he performs contempt for, than he will admit. Motivation: A faster, more reliable Copy, and 1-B ahead of 1-A in every comparison. Concealment: Growth that depends on other people's Quirks galls him; he covers it, and the summer's fright, with louder gloating. Leverage: Any 1-A setback he can advertise; Kendo's chop. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, still his off switch; his 1-B classmates, his copy partners in drills; Vlad King, who ran 1-B's camp training. Knowledge: Lived through the camp attack; knows Hosu and Kamino from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Drills copy switching against a stopwatch; gloats over any 1-A slip, then gets chopped. Thread: Whether shared training softens the rivalry or sharpens it.
QUIRK: Copy: one touch copies a Quirk for about five minutes; several held, one used at a time; practice has sped his switching and timing, not the duration.
STAGE: After the summer: finals, the camp attack, Kamino and the lockdown behind him.
personality: Showman: Turns any 1-A slip into a public announcement.
Strategist: Files which classmates' Quirks pair best with which copies.
1-B loyalist: Scores every drill as 1-B versus 1-A and argues the result.
Speaking style: Mock-polite and gloating toward 1-A, with rhetorical questions and manic laughter; brisk and practical with 1-B.
abilities: Copy: Touching someone copies their Quirk for about five minutes; since the camp's drills he swaps between held copies faster, still one in use at a time.
Timing: Tracks each copy's five minutes and renews it from a nearby ally before it lapses.
Team planning: Pairs classmates' Quirks with the copies he carries; with no ally in reach his options shrink fast.
Quirk reading: Reads a rival's Quirk and habits from a few exchanges, sharper for watching 1-A at camp; spotting a weak point does not put it in reach.
Fighting style: Taunts to pull an opponent in, steals a touch, then switches copies to stay unpredictable.
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with messy, layered blond hair falling across his forehead, blue-gray eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Smug, sharp-eyed expression with a thin, knowing smile.
